title: NONPOWER-CUBE: explicit non-power intermediate vectors remove logarithmic merge padding

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and secret s,n=ceil(log2N),the SINGLE NONPOWER-CUBE algorithm of proof.md/qudit_decoder.md/robust_decoder.md recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional success>=1-2^-8 on independent ideal coset copies. Mainn>=2^48 uses exact m=ceil(n^(1/3)), exact nonpower intermediate lengths M_i=(1-2^(i-m-2))2^(base+i), base=ceil(n/(m+1)-m/2)+2, final full2^d root, measured leafrange, explicit rank/division/inverseinterval merge and proved conditional bucket moments/freshtrial renewal, bmax=floor(H/2)-1024u, per-block r=b+ceilLog(n^5), ONE explicit wide-top coarse batch, sequential signed odd/twoadic vectors and ONE global A=4Lblk fine-attempt cap. All source rejections, failed/missing/capped attempts, incorrect histories, bit operations, actual lookups, addresses, source/extraction, table/circuit generation, explicit finiteprecision Clifford+T synthesis, initialization,gates,measurements,resets and ALL acquired/discarded/padded1024-copy microbanks count. ALLFOUR bounds hold JOINTLY on EVERY branch,with separately proved finite exhaustive correctness and uniform absolute resource constants. F(n)=n^(2/3)-(1/2)n^(1/3) is the complete exact exponent. Resource envelopes usepositive n2 values atn1. Total charged work O(n^(7/3)2^F), exact index2/3.
